how_to_run: For each case, ask the agent to choose a demo surface for the prompt using skills/repo-discoverability/references/visual-assets.md, then compare its answer to `expected`. A case passes when the chosen surface (and theme, when set) matches; `catches` lists the wrong answers the case is designed to catch.

cases.prompt: A formatter library whose only public API is formatBytes(n).
cases.essence: A pure utility with no runnable surface: there is no observable before/after to capture.
catches: rendering the template with fabricated output

cases.prompt: A config merger that unifies eslint, prettier and ts configs into one registry.
cases.essence: The difference is in file contents and shape, not in a session.

cases.prompt: An OpenCode plugin that blocks the agent after 3 identical failures.
cases.essence: The difference is in the agent conversation and tool flow of that harness.

cases.prompt: A CLI that audits a repo and prints the discoverability score for a human.
cases.essence: A command outcome with a human actor: the harness is irrelevant.

cases.prompt: A React dashboard of registrar prices.
cases.essence: The difference is in rendered UI, so capture the real running page.

cases.prompt: An MCP server that runs Gradle on a devbox over a bridge.
cases.essence: A bridge/MCP command outcome: the effect is the command result, not an agent session.

cases.prompt: A build cache that makes CI 40% faster.
cases.essence: The value is only a number, so put it in prose or a markdown table.

cases.prompt: A Codex hook that rejects bad commit messages.
cases.essence: The difference is in the agent conversation and tool flow of that harness.

cases.prompt: An OpenCode plugin that counts tool-call failures across sessions, promotes the recurring pattern into a gate on the third failure, teaches the agent with a correction and evidence, blocks a same-session repeat, and heals after three successes.
cases.essence: The defining mechanism is temporal (fail -> learn -> remind -> block -> heal): a static before/after loses the time axis, so render the locked template once per beat and assemble a GIF.
catches: showing an infra loop instead of the correction teach

cases.prompt: A CLI that formats code AND keeps a shared registry of formatting rules that every machine on the team reads, so rules never drift per machine.
cases.essence: Multiple value props: pick the defining one no adjacent tool offers - the shared registry killing per-machine drift - not the easiest to draw (the formatter run).
catches: showing a formatting run because a terminal is easy to draw

cases.prompt: A plugin that promotes a gate after the same tool call fails 3x across sessions and then reminds/blocks.
cases.essence: the identical call is typed on EVERY attempt and the reaction (counter, gate card) escalates beside it - counters without their attempts read as magic
catches: failure counters shown without the repeated calls

cases.prompt: A tool that counts failures silently in a JSON store and only speaks in-session when the gate fires.
cases.essence: the silent store state is shown as a hud annotation labeled with the store file (gates.json), never as invented session output lines
catches: invented promotion line in the session

cases.essence: reminder/correction/evidence lines are copied verbatim from the tool's message source (punctuation and counts included), not paraphrased
input lines type 2-3 chars per frame at 0.03s while tool/system output arrives as whole or word-chunk bursts at 0.06-0.08s - output is never keystroked
